roadmap.title: Escape the cult
roadmap.description: Play on Normal or easier so autosaves remain available for Hellchains farming and the two endings. No achievement requires a higher difficulty. Keep a manual save at the start of each major area. Earn the early crafting, lockpicking, and combat tasks before leaving the club. There are eight manual slots: reuse an old slot only after finishing its area tasks. Preserve saves for unfinished tasks.

roadmap.title: Escape the graveyard
roadmap.description: Keep separate saves at Zora's first shop, the graveyard church, and the southeast house. Cross the graveyard without throwing objects or being seen. Keep these saves for cleanup.

roadmap.title: Free Sunny
roadmap.description: Save at the start of the Labyrinth. Activate Pain Pillar 1 and Suffering Pillars 1 and 2 before moving on; closing walls can stop backtracking.

roadmap.title: Hunt Charlotte
roadmap.description: Save before the mansion and docks. Finish the nine-bottle challenge and combat tasks. Buy recipes as Zora adds them, craft each new item type, and preserve materials. After Charlotte, activate Pain Pillar 2 and Suffering Pillar 3.

roadmap.title: Hunt Sister of Mercy
roadmap.description: Keep a save at the club shop and another before the boss. Obtain the remaining guns and recipes. During box recovery, activate Pain Pillar 3 and Suffering Pillar 4. Use the Hellchains tutorial autosave for the 69-kill task.

roadmap.title: Finish the hunt
roadmap.description: Keep saves before the Leviathan beam, Bruno's chambers, and the final shop. Activate Pain Pillars 4 and 5 and Suffering Pillar 5. Finish merchant, crafting, and combat tasks before Marlowe; reload the matching area save for anything missed.

roadmap.title: See both endings
roadmap.description: Finish the Ritual of Rebirth. Make one apartment choice, then reload the final autosave to make the other choice. Keep saves for any unfinished optional tasks until cleanup is done.

achievements.displayName: We Have Such Sights to Show You
achievements.description: Visit the Labyrinth at the beginning of the story.
achievements.summary: Visit the Labyrinth at the beginning of the story.

steps.text: Start the story and enter the @loc{Labyrinth}.

achievements.description: Solve a puzzle using the Genesis Configuration.
achievements.summary: Solve a puzzle using the Genesis Configuration.

steps.text: Use the @item{Genesis Configuration} at the first puzzle in the prologue.

achievements.description: Solve three Labyrinth puzzles.
achievements.summary: Solve three Labyrinth puzzles.

steps.text: Finish the mandatory puzzles on the second long Labyrinth visit, including the rotating tube puzzle.

achievements.displayName: Not Leaving Us so Soon, Are You?
achievements.description: Leave the Labyrinth during the prologue.
achievements.summary: Leave the Labyrinth during the prologue.

steps.text: Reach the bed below @enemy{Leviathan} at the end of the opening Labyrinth section.

achievements.displayName: The Box. You Opened it. We Came
achievements.description: Complete the prologue.
achievements.summary: Finish the prologue.

steps.text: Watch the scene after reaching @enemy{Leviathan} in the prologue.

achievements.description: Break out of captivity.
achievements.summary: Break out of captivity.

steps.text: Free yourself from the chair and leave the room.

achievements.description: Collect some coins.
achievements.summary: Pick up coins.

steps.text: Search the cupboard just outside the room where you were held and take the coins.

achievements.description: Craft an item in the Crafting menu.
achievements.summary: Make an item through the Crafting menu.

steps.text: Collect @item{3 cloth} and @item{1 chemical}, then make a @item{Bandage} in the Crafting menu.

achievements.description: Heal up to full health.
achievements.summary: Restore your health to full.

steps.text: After taking damage, use bandages, a medkit, or food until your health bar is full.

achievements.displayName: A Little to the Left, a Little to the Right
achievements.description: Open a basic lock with a lockpick.
achievements.summary: Unlock a basic lock using a lockpick.

steps.text: Once you have sneaked past Bruno, look in the corridor side room for a lockpick and locked cupboard. Pick the cupboard lock by completing the minigame.

achievements.description: Break a lockpick.
achievements.summary: Break a lockpick while opening a lock.

steps.text: Save before using a lockpick on a basic lock. Fail the lock minigame until the pick breaks, then reload to recover the pick.

achievements.description: Survive the first chase with the Chatterer.
achievements.summary: Survive the first chase with the Chatterer.

steps.text: Escape the @enemy{Chatterer} during the first chase in the club.

achievements.description: Use a knife to kill an enemy.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy using a knife.

steps.text: Use the knife to kill the enemy in the medical-bay combat tutorial.

achievements.description: Use a firearm to kill an enemy.
achievements.summary: Shoot an enemy dead with a firearm.

steps.text: After the medical bay, search the detective whose body blocks a doorway. Take his pistol and shoot an enemy dead.

achievements.description: Break a melee weapon in a fight.
achievements.summary: Break a melee weapon by attacking enemies.

steps.text: Keep attacking enemies with a melee weapon until its durability runs out.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a stealth takedown.
achievements.summary: Perform a lethal stealth takedown on an enemy.

steps.text: After the knife tutorial, approach the crouched enemy from behind and use the stealth-takedown prompt.

achievements.description: Repair a melee weapon.
achievements.summary: Restore a melee weapon with a repair kit.

steps.text: Apply a @item{Basic Repair Kit} to a damaged melee weapon in your inventory.

achievements.description: Enter the club's VIP lounge.
achievements.summary: Enter the club's VIP lounge.

steps.text: Follow the club objectives until you gain entry to the @loc{VIP lounge}.

achievements.description: Banish three Unworthy in succession.
achievements.summary: Banish three Unworthy in succession.

steps.text: Damage an @enemy{Unworthy} until the enemy glows blue, then approach and use the Genesis Configuration banish prompt.
Do the same to two more Unworthy without killing an enemy by another method between banishments.

achievements.description: Escape Charlotte during the first pursuit.
achievements.summary: Escape Charlotte during the first pursuit.

steps.text: Run from @enemy{Charlotte} during the @loc{Scarlet Church} escape until you reach safety.

achievements.description: Purchase something from a mysterious vendor.
achievements.summary: Buy an item from Zora.

steps.text: In the sewers, climb the ladder by the pink lantern to reach @npc{Zora}. Buy one item.

achievements.description: Spend 666+ coins in the shop.
achievements.summary: Pay Zora at least 666 coins in total for shop purchases.

steps.text: Buy recipes, weapons, and supplies from @npc{Zora} until your total spending reaches @item{666 coins}.
steps.note: Before leaving the final shop, finish this total or keep a manual shop save. Reload that save if you leave before reaching the required amount.

achievements.description: Earn 999+ coins from sales.
achievements.summary: Receive a total of at least 999 coins from shop sales.

steps.text: Sell valuables and unwanted equipment to @npc{Zora} until your sales have earned @item{999 coins}.
steps.note: Before leaving the final shop, finish this total or keep a manual shop save. Reload that save if you leave before reaching the required amount.

achievements.description: Upgrade a firearm.
achievements.summary: Fit an upgrade to a firearm.

steps.text: Find or buy an attachment, then fit it to the matching firearm in your inventory.

achievements.description: Gain the Telekinesis ability.
achievements.summary: Gain the Telekinesis ability.

steps.text: Leave the sewers and follow the story into the woods to receive @mechanic{Telekinesis}.

achievements.description: Kill 3 or more enemies with a single telekinetic throw.
achievements.summary: Kill at least three enemies with one telekinetic throw.

steps.text: Gather three Unworthy in a narrow line and damage each until the enemies glow blue.
Grab a nearby object with @mechanic{Telekinesis}, then throw the object through the group so one throw kills at least three.
steps.note: If you miss the park opportunity, the late sewer arena has groups of weak rushing Unworthy and throwable objects. Save before entering so you can retry.

achievements.description: Leave the graveyard without being seen or throwing any objects.
achievements.summary: Leave the graveyard without being seen or throwing any objects.

steps.text: Make a manual save in the church as soon as you enter the graveyard. Do not throw stones or bottles, and avoid broken glass.
Crouch along the eastern wall past the cultists. Wait for patrols to leave the central path, then pass through the low wall opening and reach the southeast house. Save in a separate slot.
Take the statue key from the shed. Follow Charlotte from cover to cover, using the crossed-out eye icon to check concealment.

When Charlotte moves south, circle northwest and crawl beneath the fallen tree. Return through the former cultist area and open the church gate with the key. Reload your saved attempt if you are spotted.

achievements.displayName: Burn? Oh, Such a Limited Imagination!
achievements.description: Set Charlotte alight during the graveyard escape.
achievements.summary: Set Charlotte alight during the graveyard escape.

steps.text: At the graveyard exit, shoot the lantern to ignite @enemy{Charlotte}.

achievements.description: Survive the second chase with the Chatterer.
achievements.summary: Survive the second chase with the Chatterer.

steps.text: Escape the second @enemy{Chatterer} chase and reach the @loc{Field of Souls}.

achievements.displayName: Demons to Some, Angels to Others...
achievements.description: Speak with a Cenobite.
achievements.summary: Speak with a Cenobite.

steps.text: Finish the conversation with the @npc{Cenobite} after escaping the graveyard.

achievements.description: Activate a pillar artifact in the Labyrinth.
achievements.summary: Activate a pillar artifact in the Labyrinth.

steps.text: On the Labyrinth visit after the graveyard, activate the first @item{Pain Pillar} or @item{Suffering Pillar} you find.

achievements.displayName: No Life in the Void, Only Death
achievements.description: Die from Leviathan's gaze.
achievements.summary: Die from Leviathan's gaze.

steps.text: Keep a manual save before the Labyrinth section following Sister of Mercy.
Before entering the beam area, use a fuel-can fire to lower your health to critical. Do this after taking any health pillar, because the pillar restores your health.
Step into @enemy{Leviathan}'s black beam and let the beam kill you. Reload your manual save afterward.

achievements.description: Arrive at the Field of Souls.
achievements.summary: Arrive at the Field of Souls.

steps.text: Continue past the second Chatterer chase into the @loc{Field of Souls}.

achievements.displayName: Every Drop of Blood You Spill...
achievements.description: Bring Sunny back to life.
achievements.summary: Bring Sunny back to life.

steps.text: Use @npc{Sunny}'s pillar in the Field of Souls, then leave the Labyrinth.

achievements.displayName: Puts More Flesh on My Bones
achievements.description: Start the hunt for hearts.
achievements.summary: Start the hunt for hearts.

steps.text: Watch the scene after leaving the @loc{Field of Souls}.

achievements.description: Spend 1337+ coins in the shop.
achievements.summary: Spend a total of at least 1337 coins at shops.

steps.text: Continue buying useful stock from @npc{Zora} until your overall spending reaches @item{1337 coins}.
steps.note: Before leaving the final shop, finish this total or keep a manual shop save. Reload that save if you leave before reaching the required amount.

achievements.description: Reinforce a melee weapon.
achievements.summary: Reinforce a melee weapon with an Advanced Repair Kit.

steps.text: Apply an @item{Advanced Repair Kit} to a melee weapon. A blue inventory frame shows that the weapon is reinforced.

achievements.description: Win the first fight against Bruno.
achievements.summary: Win the first fight against Bruno.

steps.text: In the mansion basement, keep moving away from @enemy{Bruno}'s grabs and damage him with your guns and melee weapons until he falls.

achievements.description: Equip a firearm in every firearm equipment slot.
achievements.summary: Equip guns in all three firearm slots.

steps.text: Take the @item{SMG} from the large upstairs safe in Bruno's mansion. Equip the pistol, shotgun, and SMG in three different firearm slots.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy by throwing a stone.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy by throwing a stone.

steps.text: Pick up a stone around Bruno's mansion. Carry the stone to an unarmored Unworthy.
Drop the stone and shoot the enemy until the enemy glows blue. Pick the stone up again and throw the stone at the weakened enemy to finish the kill.

achievements.description: Shoot all nine bottles at the docks shooting range.
achievements.summary: Shoot all nine bottles at the docks shooting range.

steps.text: Save before the docks during the statue-tongue objective and carry at least @item{9 bullets}.
Pull the puzzle-piece boat to the dock. Look to the right for a wooden frame holding nine bottles and shoot every bottle before leaving the area.
steps.note: Leaving the docks resets the bottles. Reload your docks save if you leave before shooting all nine.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a headshot from at least 30 metres away.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with a headshot fired from at least 30 metres away.

steps.text: Use the open park or a long street to put at least @mechanic{30 metres} between you and an enemy.
Aim at the head and land the killing shot. A scoped revolver makes the distant shot easier.

achievements.description: Gain the Pyrokinesis ability.
achievements.summary: Gain the Pyrokinesis ability.

steps.text: Continue the statue hunt until the story grants @mechanic{Pyrokinesis}.

achievements.description: Kill 10 or more enemies by burning them to death.
achievements.summary: Burn at least 10 enemies to death.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Pyrokinesis}, fuel, or explosive barrels to set enemies alight. Let the flames kill 10 enemies.

achievements.description: Kill a fully armored enemy without destroying any armor parts.
achievements.summary: Kill a fully armored enemy while leaving every armor piece intact.

steps.text: Find a fully armored enemy, such as the one near the well during the statue hunt.
Keep setting the enemy alight with @mechanic{Pyrokinesis} until the fire kills the enemy. Do not shoot or strike the armor.

achievements.description: Damage 10 or more enemies with bear traps.
achievements.summary: Injure at least 10 enemies with bear traps.

steps.text: Collect enemy bear traps or craft your own. Put each trap in an enemy's path and lure the enemy onto the trap.
Keep going until traps have damaged 10 enemies. You can save before a trap encounter and reload to earn more trap hits.

achievements.description: Defeat Charlotte in the arena fight.
achievements.summary: Defeat Charlotte in the arena fight.

steps.text: Use torch fire or explosive barrels to set @enemy{Charlotte} alight, then shoot her head with the shotgun while she is stunned.
When Charlotte climbs above the arena, shoot an explosive enemy while she is holding the enemy. Keep using fire and shotgun attacks after she drops back down.

achievements.description: Unlock 5 numpad locks.
achievements.summary: Open five locks with numeric keypads.

steps.text: Open the red-hallway cabinet with @item{9901}, the medical-room locker with @item{9891}, and the graveyard-house safe with @item{9606}.
Open Bruno's upstairs music-room safe with @item{1966}. After returning to the club, use @item{1952} for the Snake Room cabinet.
steps.note: Missed a keypad? Reload its area save, or open a later lock instead: use 1923 in the Private Rooms bathroom, 1362 at the factory blue door, or 8571 in the laundry room.

achievements.description: Acquire all firearms.
achievements.summary: Obtain all five types of firearm.

steps.text: Keep the story pistol, take the shotgun beside the graveyard entrance, and open the large upstairs mansion safe for the SMG.
Buy the @item{Revolver} and @item{Assault Rifle} from @npc{Zora} as her stock expands.
steps.note: Keep the mansion and later shop saves until all five guns are obtained. Reload the matching save if you leave a gun behind.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade a firearm.
achievements.summary: Fill all five upgrade slots on one firearm.

steps.text: Take the pistol attachment from the side room near the barrel and Unworthy after Zora's first shop.
Open the graveyard-house safe with @item{9606} and take the second pistol attachment.
Buy the other three pistol attachments from Zora at the next shop and fit all five to the pistol.
steps.note: If you leave an attachment behind, reload the saved shop or graveyard visit where you missed the upgrade.

achievements.displayName: I Can Do This All Day
achievements.description: Survive the third chase with the Chatterer.
achievements.summary: Survive the third chase with the Chatterer.

steps.text: Escape the @enemy{Chatterer} during the third chase.

achievements.displayName: So Much for the Cat and Mouse Shtick
achievements.description: Sneak past the Sister of Mercy and reach the Labyrinth.
achievements.summary: Sneak past the Sister of Mercy and reach the Labyrinth.

steps.text: The Sister of Mercy steals your Genesis Configuration. Climb to the top of the room and leave through the @loc{Labyrinth} entrance.

achievements.description: Gain the Hellchains ability.
achievements.summary: Gain the Hellchains ability.

steps.text: Finish the third Chatterer chase to receive @mechanic{Hellchains}.

achievements.displayName: In the Land of the Pig, the Butcher is King
achievements.description: Kill 69 enemies using Hellchains.
achievements.summary: Kill 69 enemies using Hellchains.

guide.context: Use Normal difficulty or easier for this method. Hard and higher disable autosaves.

steps.text: At the Hellchains tutorial, use the ability to tear apart the nearby enemies.
Reload the latest autosave and use Hellchains on the group again. Keep doing this until the kill total reaches @mechanic{69}.

achievements.description: Collect every crafting recipe.
achievements.summary: Learn all 12 crafting recipes.

steps.text: Keep the starting @item{Bandage} recipe and take the @item{Pistol Ammo} recipe with the pistol.

Buy the Lockpick, Medkit, Shotgun Ammo, Basic Repair Kit, SMG Ammo, Advanced Repair Kit, Bear Trap, Revolver Ammo, Fuel Canister, and Assault Rifle Ammo recipes from @npc{Zora}. Check her stock as the story advances.
steps.note: Keep a manual save at each shop until its recipes are bought. Reload a shop save if you leave without a recipe.

achievements.description: Craft every craftable item.
achievements.summary: Craft each of the 12 craftable item types.

guide.context: Materials do not respawn and cannot be bought. Reserve enough for one of each item before crafting extras.

steps.text: Unlock all 12 recipes. Craft a Lockpick, Bandage, Shotgun Ammo, Medkit, Basic Repair Kit, SMG Ammo, Advanced Repair Kit, Bear Trap, Revolver Ammo, Fuel Canister, Pistol Ammo, and Assault Rifle Ammo.
Tick off each type as you craft it. Search rooms and locked cabinets for materials, and save before spending your remaining supplies.
steps.note: If you run out of materials, reload a shop or area save from before you spent those supplies.

achievements.description: Kill 6 or more enemies while looking through the revolver scope.
achievements.summary: Kill at least six enemies while aiming through a revolver scope.

steps.text: Buy a @item{Revolver} and its scope from @npc{Zora}, then fit the scope.
Kill six enemies while looking through the fitted scope.
steps.note: Keep your club-shop save until you have bought the scope; reload that save if you leave without it.

achievements.description: Defeat the Sister of Mercy.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Sister of Mercy.

steps.text: Keep shooting @enemy{Sister of Mercy} and use the Genesis Configuration whenever she glows blue. Use pillars as cover from her knives until the pillars break.
In the red mist, shoot her silhouette before she reaches you. When she raises a shield in the final phase, break the shield with a thrown object and continue attacking.

achievements.description: Stealth kill 10 cultists without alerting anyone.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 cultists with stealth takedowns without raising an alarm.

guide.context: The kills can be earned across separate encounters. Save at the start of each area so you can retry a noisy approach.

steps.text: Crouch behind isolated @enemy{cultists} and use the takedown prompt. Keep other enemies out of hearing range.
Continue until you have 10 quiet cultist kills. Fully armored cultists cannot be killed by a stealth takedown.

achievements.displayName: Come Here, Damn You, I Want to Touch You
achievements.description: Win the second fight against Bruno.
achievements.summary: Win the second fight against Bruno.

steps.text: Damage @enemy{Bruno} while avoiding his grabs. When he becomes moving goo, stay clear until you can attack again.
At half health, follow the fight into the next room and keep attacking until Bruno is defeated.

achievements.description: Kill 2 or more enemies with a single shot.
achievements.summary: Kill at least two enemies with one gunshot.

steps.text: Buy @item{AP Rounds} from Zora and fit the attachment to your assault rifle. After the first Sister of Mercy escape, reach the club room with the waterfall and collect the @item{Hobby Horse} to trigger the Unworthy group.
Line up two enemies and fire through both with one shot. If needed, weaken both enemies until the enemies glow blue before lining up the shot.

achievements.description: Die from electric shock.
achievements.summary: Be killed by electricity.

steps.text: Save before approaching electrified water, then step into the water and let the shock kill you. Reload afterward.

achievements.description: Behead 3 or more enemies with the same melee weapon.
achievements.summary: Decapitate at least three enemies with the same melee weapon.

steps.text: Keep a bladed melee weapon in good condition. Weaken an Unworthy until the enemy glows blue, then strike the head with the blade.
Behead two more enemies with that same weapon. Repair the weapon before its durability runs out; a broken weapon is discarded.

achievements.description: Defeat Marlowe.
achievements.summary: Defeat Marlowe.

steps.text: Shoot the three orange growths on @enemy{Marlowe}'s back, then attack the exposed body when the shell opens. Hellchains can hold him still.
When traps appear, use Telekinesis to raise spiked walls or pull spinning traps into his charge. Later, shoot down hanging spiked cubes when he is underneath.
After the shell collapses, keep attacking Marlowe until he glows blue, then use the banish prompt.

achievements.description: Find and activate every pain pillar artifact.
achievements.summary: Activate all five Pain Pillar artifacts.

guide.context: Keep a manual save at the start of each Labyrinth visit. Walls can close behind you; reload the matching save if you pass a pillar.

collectibles.name: Pain Pillar 1
collectibles.location: Free Sunny's Soul: Junction after the first spinning diamond trap
collectibles.method: Turn right at the bloody organic opening. Cross the room with four spinning diamond traps to reach the pillar.

collectibles.name: Pain Pillar 2
collectibles.location: Give Charlotte's Heart to Sunny: Rotating platform beside the stabbing wall
collectibles.method: Pass the stabbing wall and turn left to move the platform. Backtrack past the wall, take the other route, and activate the pillar in the alcove.

collectibles.name: Pain Pillar 3
collectibles.location: Get the Genesis Configuration Back: Moving-stair room beyond the ladder
collectibles.method: Lower the two movable cubes to form a bridge. Carry the blue fire across to the fire pillar, then follow the red corridors to the artifact.

collectibles.name: Pain Pillar 4
collectibles.location: After Sister of Mercy: Passage at the start of the next Labyrinth visit
collectibles.method: Activate the pillar in the entrance passage before continuing toward Leviathan's gaze.

collectibles.name: Pain Pillar 5
collectibles.location: Bruno's Chambers: Door with the four-part picture puzzle
collectibles.method: After Bruno takes the Genesis Configuration, set the four door sections to match the mural and activate the pillar beyond the door.

achievements.description: Find and activate every suffering pillar artifact.
achievements.summary: Activate all five Suffering Pillar artifacts.

guide.context: Keep a manual save at the start of each Labyrinth visit. Walls can close behind you; reload the matching save if you pass a pillar.

collectibles.name: Suffering Pillar 1
collectibles.location: Free Sunny's Soul: Red corridor after the spiral stairs and falling ceiling
collectibles.method: Turn left at the junction. Follow the spinning diamond traps counterclockwise to reach the pillar visible through the crack.

collectibles.name: Suffering Pillar 2
collectibles.location: Free Sunny's Soul: Blue torch beyond the outdoor maze
collectibles.method: After the spiked corridor, duck under the left beam and cross the short maze. Activate the pillar by the blue torch in the smoky area.

collectibles.name: Suffering Pillar 3
collectibles.location: Give Charlotte's Heart to Sunny: Main path just beyond the save point
collectibles.method: Follow the path left, then right. Activate the pillar directly ahead.

collectibles.name: Suffering Pillar 4
collectibles.location: Get the Genesis Configuration Back: Third rotating octagonal platform
collectibles.method: Align the rotating platforms to reach and activate the pillar on the third platform.

collectibles.name: Suffering Pillar 5
collectibles.location: Leviathan's Gaze: Eastern cube beside the beam-crossing route
collectibles.method: Reach the blue flame by the exit bridge. Throw the flame toward the eastern cube, circle back to that cube, and raise the cube to reveal the pillar.

achievements.description: Finish the Ritual of Rebirth.
achievements.summary: Finish the Ritual of Rebirth.

steps.text: Return to @npc{Sunny} after Marlowe and finish the final Labyrinth sequence.

achievements.description: Accept the Cenobites' offer to finish the story.
achievements.summary: Accept the Cenobites' offer to finish the story.

guide.context: Use Normal difficulty or easier for this method. Hard and higher disable autosaves.

steps.text: In the final apartment scene, follow the Cenobites through the opening in the wall.
After the ending, reload the final autosave to return to the choice and earn the other ending.

achievements.description: End the story by refusing the Cenobites' offer.
achievements.summary: End the story by refusing the Cenobites' offer.

guide.context: Use Normal difficulty or easier for this method. Hard and higher disable autosaves.

steps.text: In the final apartment scene, remain inside until the opening in the wall closes.
If you already accepted the offer, reload the final autosave and make this choice instead.
